verdict.rationale: Notte's own docs say deployed scripts become serverless Functions that you can "invoke and schedule anywhere", so scheduling is a first-party claim tied to its workflow deployment feature. That claim is a single marketing line, and the Functions doc excerpt is truncated. Nothing shows how recurring schedules are configured or whether scheduling is native or relies on external callers. Missing for 10: documented recurring/cron schedule configuration, details on native vs external scheduling, schedule management (pause/edit/history), independent or hands-on corroboration.
